svg.title: S1 — Write → event → projection on every replica (US106; the same flow for US106a, US109, US208)

g.text: S1 — Write → event → projection on every replica (US106; the same flow for US106a, US109, US208)
(read model has the airports of ALL replicas)
COMMIT (write model + read model + processed event, atomically)
E1 not processed → upsert FAO (owner airports-1, version 0)
airports-1 already processed E1 → skipped as duplicate
Eventual consistency: between the commit on airports-1 and step 21, airports-2 does not know FAO yet.
A failure applying E1 → retried with back-off, then moved to airports-2.airports.dlq.
Rollback → nothing is published (the relay only runs AFTER_COMMIT).
